# UC-201 — Export a Store Report as CSV

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-201
- **Title:** Export a Store Report as CSV
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Manager/Owner staff
- **Trigger:** Vendor clicks Export on a store report opened in UC-200
- **Priority:** P2
- **Goal:** Download the same report dataset as a safe, spreadsheet-ready CSV file for offline analysis.
- **Preconditions:** A valid report family and range selected; own `store_id` scope (BR-VND-07); store active.

## Main Scenario
1. Vendor clicks Export CSV → client `GET /store/reports/{family}/export?from&to` requests the stream (touchpoint `API-ANL-003`).
2. System streams `text/csv` inline with `Content-Disposition: attachment` — UTF-8 BOM present, ≤50,000 rows.
3. Every cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` is prefixed with `'` to neutralize spreadsheet formula injection.
4. Money columns are whole integer YER; totals match the on-screen report of UC-200 (same underlying dataset).
5. Server computes rows via the report queue (BR-PLT-01) and streams them; repeated downloads always return current figures.
6. The file saves locally; no platform-side copy of the export is retained.

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Large range near the cap:** Result set approaches 50,000 rows → full file returned with cap enforced at the boundary.
- **A2 — Role check:** Viewer staff without export rights are refused at the endpoint; Manager/Owner proceed.
- **A3 — Platform sibling:** Platform-level report exports are generated by `UC-081` — this UC covers the vendor's own store only.

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Row cap exceeded:** More than 50,000 rows → `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`; vendor narrows the range and re-exports.
- **E2 — Stream failure mid-download:** Connection drops → the client re-issues the read (retry discipline, BR-PLT-02); partial files are never trusted.
- **E3 — Store suspended or foreign scope:** `STORE_SUSPENDED` / `404 NOT_FOUND` — only own-store rows can ever appear (BR-VND-07).

## Postconditions
- Read-only: exporting mutates no ledger, order or report data.
- Vendor holds a CSV identical in figures to the on-screen report.

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-PLT-01, BR-PLT-02, BR-VND-07

## Related Requirements
- FR-018 (Analytics & Reporting)
- Cross-reference: `UC-081` generates platform report export files; this use case is the store-level export.

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Manager/Owner of the own store (BR-VND-07); exports never include other stores' rows.
- **Data involved:** CSV file (UTF-8 BOM), report rows, integer YER amounts, guarded formula cells.
- **External dependencies:** Report queue and retry/DLQ handling (BR-PLT-01, BR-PLT-02); contract `API-ANL-003`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC201-01:** Given a 10-row report, when exported, then a CSV downloads with UTF-8 BOM and integer YER amounts.
- **AC-UC201-02:** Given a cell beginning `=`, when written, then it is prefixed with `'` (formula injection guard).
- **AC-UC201-03:** Given a result set over 50,000 rows, when exported, then `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` is returned.
- **AC-UC201-04:** Given foreign store data exists, when exporting, then no foreign row appears (BR-VND-07).
